mapper.select: /*selectMasterMpDsPckpaprDesignRemarkHistoryPopList*/ SELECT ROWNUM SEQ ,A.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,TO_CHAR(A.CHANGE_DATE ,'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHANGE_DATE ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS USER_NAME_LOC ,A.REQ_USER_NAME ,A.REQ_USER_REMARK ,A.RE_REMARK ,A.CH_REMARK ,DECODE(A.RE_REMARK,'',DECODE(A.CH_REMARK,'',0,1),1) AS REMARK_IMG FROM DONGOPKG_REMARK_HISTORY A WHERE A.PLANT =#{st_plant} AND A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE =#{st_byca_comorg_code} AND A.BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND A.OPKG_SEQ =#{st_opkg_seq} AND A.RD_DATE =#{st_rd_date} AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO =#{st_buyer_item_no} ORDER BY SEQ DESC
